name: Sun Care Duo for Face and Body
subtitle: For: Tan correction and sun protection
usageInstructions: Apply a generous amount of body wash to your palms or loofah. Massage onto wet skin in a circular motion. Rinse thoroughly
description: Head-to-toe SPF 50+ protection in one pack. Built with new-gen filters so you're protected end to end. Why the duo •SPF 50+ PA++++ broad-spectrum protection for face and body •Sunscreen that blends in 3 seconds •Body SPF that leaves no white cast •Body SPF that actively corrects existing tan with unique de-tan blend •Sunscreen that is acne-safe
usage: Step 1- Face On cleansed skin; apply a coin-sized amount of Ultra Light Sunscreen to your face, neck, and ears. Step 2- Body Squeeze a generous amount of De-Tan SPF Body Lotion onto arms, legs, neck, chest, feet, and the back of your hands. Massage in. Don't skip high-tan zones: wrists, arms, legs. Step 3-Reapply Every 2–3 hours if you're outdoors, sweating, or swimming. Apply 15 minutes before stepping out for best protection.

list.title: Why do I need two different sunscreens for face and body?
list.content: Face skin is thinner, acne-prone, and spends more time under makeup — it needs a lightweight, non-comedogenic formula. Body skin is thicker and more exposed -it needs a hydrating, tan-correcting formula with a stronger moisture base. Using one for both leaves gaps in protection or causes breakouts.

list.title: Is SPF 50+ PA++++ enough for daily use?
list.content: Yes. SPF 50+ blocks around 98% of UVB rays, and PA++++ is the highest UVA protection rating available - ideal for Indian sun exposure. Reapply every 2–3 hours if you're outdoors.

list.title: How long before I see the tan reduce?
list.content: Tan correction is gradual. With daily use and consistent reapplication, most users notice more even skin tone within a few weeks. Results vary with skin type and sun exposure.

list.title: Will it leave a white cast?
list.content: No. Both formulas are designed for Indian skin tones. The face sunscreen has an aqua-gel texture that disappears in 3 seconds; the body lotion absorbs clean with no ghostly film.

list.title: Is the face sunscreen safe for acne-prone skin?
list.content: Yes- it contains ACZERO, a Korean anti-acne technology that is non-comedogenic and anti-inflammatory, tested safe even on active-acne skin.

list.title: Is it water and sweat resistant?
list.content: The face sunscreen is clinically proven water and sweat resistant up to 80 minutes. The body lotion is non-transferring once absorbed. Reapply after swimming or heavy sweating.

list.title: Can I wear the face sunscreen under makeup?
list.content: Yes. Apply after moisturiser, wait 60 seconds, then proceed with your makeup. It won't pill or ball up.

list.title: Is this duo suitable for men?
list.content: Yes. Both formulas are gender-neutral and built around skin type and skin zone, not gender.
